s1.where: the greeting page with the writing box at the bottom
s1.expectation: The start page for a new conversation with Claude, before anything has been written.
s1.cue: The writing box that says 'Chat with Claude...', the empty middle, and the greeting 'Back at it, Ally Cooper'.

first_pass.why: The only large words are 'Back at it, Ally Cooper'. That is a greeting to a person, not the name of a place. I work out from the empty space and the 'Chat with Claude...' box at the bottom that this is where I start a new conversation, but I have to reason my way there; nothing simply tells me. I read the greeting two or three times to check whether it is meant to be the page name.
first_pass.solution: Put a plain page name at the top, such as 'New chat', in the same spot where other screens put their name. Keep the greeting if you like, but not as the only words.

test_cases.task: The app opens on the page with the large greeting in the middle and the writing box at the bottom (if it is not already there: open the menu with the three lines at the top left and tap the big word at the top of the menu). Put the phone down, look away and count slowly to ten, then look back at the screen and, before touching anything, say where you are. Then drag the page up and down and watch whether a name for this page shows up anywhere. (The picture with the microphone warning cannot be brought back without the phone's permission prompts, so answer for that picture from this same page.)
test_cases.real_if: you still have to work out where you are from the writing box, and no name for the page appears anywhere
test_cases.not_real_if: you know straight away where you are, or a name for the page shows up
test_cases.persona_report: Looking back, the big words now said 'Good afternoon, Ally Cooper', not 'Back at it, Ally Cooper' as in the picture. I still had to work out from the 'Chat with Claude...' box that this is where I start a new conversation. When I dragged up and down, nothing moved and no page name appeared anywhere. The greeting even changes its wording, so I cannot use it as a landmark either.
test_cases.what_they_did: The app was already on the greeting page. I looked away for a moment, looked back and said where I was before touching anything. Then I dragged the page up and down.

s1.closing_comment: On the phone the greeting even changes with the time of day, so I cannot learn it as a landmark, and dragging the page never shows a name; I still have to work out where I am from the writing box.

s2.where: the side menu with nothing shaded
s2.expectation: The main menu that slides out from the left, listing Chats, Projects, Code and Artifacts.
s2.cue: The menu list itself and the big word 'Claude' at the top.

first_pass.why: I can tell I am in the menu, but the big name at the top, 'Claude', is only the app's name, and none of the four rows is shaded, so the menu does not tell me which part of the app I have come from or am in. When I open a menu to reorient, that is the one thing I need it to say.
first_pass.solution: Shade or mark the row for the part I am currently in, clearly and not faintly, and perhaps say 'Menu' or 'You are in: New chat' at the top.

test_cases.task: From the page with the greeting, tap the three lines at the top left to open the menu. Say which row, if any, shows the part of the app you came from. Then tap Chats, wait for it to open, open the menu again the same way, and compare.
test_cases.real_if: when opened from the greeting page, no row shows where you came from
test_cases.not_real_if: a row clearly shows where you came from
test_cases.persona_report: Opened from the greeting page, none of the four rows (Chats, Projects, Code, Artifacts) was shaded. There is also a 'Recents' section with two chats both called 'Untitled', and neither of those was marked. So nothing told me where I had come from. Opened again from Chats, the Chats row had a pale band behind it.
test_cases.what_they_did: From the greeting page I tapped the three lines at the top left, looked at the menu, tapped Chats, then opened the menu again from Chats.

s2.closing_comment: Opened from the greeting page, the menu marks no row at all, and the 'Recents' list shows two chats both called 'Untitled', so it tells me nothing about where I came from.

I would read it several times to be sure.

test_cases.task: From the page with the greeting, tap the small grey microphone picture in the writing box. Read the page as it is. test_cases.not_real_if: the page makes clear what it is

Nothing says whether it is a one-time introduction, a settings page or a step in a sequence, and there is no step count. It came up as a panel with an X, which makes me guess it is a one-off introduction, but that is my guess, not something written there.
test_cases.what_they_did: From the greeting page I tapped the small grey microphone in the writing box, read the page without pressing Continue or changing the language, and left with the X.

s7.closing_comment: The page still does not say whether it is an introduction, a settings page or a step, and the only hint is that it slides up with an X, which is my guess, not something the page tells me.
